NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the City of Gilroy is issuing a Notice of Funding Availability (NOFA)
for a two-year funding application cycle for the PYs 2027-2028 (July 1, 2027 - June 30, 2028) and 2028-
2029 (July 1, 2028 - June 30, 2029) CDBG Program. The City anticipates receiving approximately
$400,000 annually in Federal Fiscal Year (FFY) 2027 and FFY 2028 CDBG funds, for a total of
$800,000 from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) to be allocated to
eligible PY 2027-2028 and PY 2028-2029 activities. Successful applications will be funded over a two-
year period and the City will not release a NOFA for PY 2028 -2029.
The CDBG Program is designed to support activities that (1) benefit low - and moderate -income
persons, (2) aid in the prevention of slums or blight, and (3) meet an urgent community need. Through
this NOFA, the City invites nonprofit organizations to apply for eligible activities that primarily benefit
low- and moderate-income City of Gilroy individuals or households earning no more than 80% of the
area median income for Santa Clara County . All CDBG funds awarded through this NOFA must
be used exclusively to assist City of Gilroy residents. Housing preservation is an eligible use of
CDBG funds. HUD limits the amount of CDBG funding that may be used for public service activities to
15% of the City’s annual CDBG allocation . This NOFA covers a two-year funding cycle for the third
and fourth program years of the City’s five-year Consolidated Plan (2025-2030).
A virtual Public Hearing will be held on Wed nesday, December 9, 2026, at 6:00 PM, to obtain
community input on housing and community development needs and priorities, for the CDBG
program. Written public comments are also accepted prior to or during the hearing. The hearing
will also provide an opportunity to discuss programs and activities for the upcoming CDBG
Program PY 2027-2028 and PY 2028 -2029 NOFA, and the grant application process. All
interested community members and applicants are encouraged to attend the virtual meeting by
joining through the following link:
https://zoom.us/j/94981895640
NOTICE IS FURTHER GIVEN that public comments will be received at the virtual public hearing. Any
interested person is invited to provide comment. For additional information , please contact the Housing
and Community Services Division (HCS) at (408) 846-0290, housing@cityofgilroy.org , or at City Hall at
7351 Rosanna St., Gilroy, CA.
The CDBG application packet and additional details on this NOFA will be available on Wednesday,
December 2, 2026, at cityofgilroy.org/cdbg. For questions and/or technical assistance, contact HCS at
housing@cityofgilroy.org .
